_comment: Per-provider serving assumptions from research/batch1/03 + batch2/02. region_mix weights sum to 1. pue is [P5,P50,P95]. hardware_mix weights sum to 1 over hardware_classes ids; 'sram' providers instead use speed_premium [P5,P50,P95] applied to gpu_blackwell-modeled energy. tier_multipliers scale total energy. region_variants are customer-selectable alternatives (hyperscalers only).
